trials.text: Matrix multiplication is a mathematical operation that involves multiplying two matrices together to produce a third matrix. This operation is only possible if the number of columns in the first matrix is equal to the number of rows in the second matrix. In other words, matrix multiplication can only be performed if the matrices are "square"
